title: AUTH-115 shared-session rejection across two live pages

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given browser tabs TAB-A and TAB-B share origin and user-a SESSION-A with FMO PORTAL ADMIN owner role TEST_OWNER
2. And the dialog named "Leave Now?" on the Home page is visible in TAB-A

steps.title: Install clock "Thu Oct 22 2026 15:31:06 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
Pause clock "Thu Oct 22 2026 15:32:06 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 3. And the Category editor is visible for record 101 in the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" on the administration page in TAB-B
4. When User A in browser tab "TAB-A" clicks the button labelled "Logout" inside the dialog named "Leave Now?" on the Home page
5. And the controlled browser clock advances through the 1000-millisecond logout delay
6. And User A in browser tab "TAB-B" clicks the button labelled "Update" inside the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" on the administration page
7. And the Category update response in TAB-B rejects SESSION-A with TOKEN_INVALID_EXPIRED
8. Then the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" on the login page is visible in browser tab "TAB-B"
9. And the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" on the login page is visible in browser tab "TAB-B"
10. And the button labelled "Sign In" on the login page is visible in browser tab "TAB-B"
11. And the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is absent in browser tab "TAB-B"
12. And the alert in the portal notification area displays exactly "Expired Session, please login again."
13. And the rejected Category update response contains no category record

annotations.description: Actual React shell, Category grid, and response handler. Controlled browser identity and service responses. Cross-tab rejection does not establish BFF global revocation. Spreadsheet formula execution requires a separate viewer.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
